subject: general
question: The semicircle of area 1250 π cm² is inscribed inside a rectangle. The diameter of the semicircle coincides with the length of the rectangle. The area of the rectangle is:
solution:
**Given:**

Lenght of the Rectangle = Diameter of the semicircle

The semicircle of area =1250 π cm2 

**Formula Used**:

Area of semicircle = (π × r2)/2

Area of rectangle = Length × Width

**Solution:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/104454924d131aeee214a2f8c2cdf6c07af887fa1af67539cd27c255c682b598.png] 

According to the given conditions;

Let the length of the rectangle = 2r

Width of the rectangle = r

Area of rectangle = 2r × r

Area of rectangle = 2r²

Area of semicircle = (π × r2)/2

1250 π = (π × r2)/2

⇒ r2 = 2500

⇒ r = 50

Area of rectangle = 2r × r = 2r2

Area of rectangle = 5000

Hence option 3 is correct.
